statistics: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (n-1); all five original values retained; peak means average the observed per-run peaks, not the peak of a mean curve.
scope: Default reclaim, 0.1 s sampling, PSS off. Separate selected-file global residency, host file accounting and guest logical peaks. No cache reset, no no-sharing baseline, no whole-RAM saving. Trace gaps and differing durations are not zero-padded or interpolated into a mean curve.
